name: Paragraph reveals
source: rasya-taste-v4.3 (agent S): the statement as a paragraph that reveals, in place of a few words set huge
look: One paragraph of 25 to 60 words in the display face (48px at 1440, about 42 characters a line) in a section sized to it: its words rest in the muted colour at 30% and turn to full ink one after another (or a line at a time) as the paragraph's top climbs from 80% to 35% of the screen; scrubbed, it runs back on the way up; finished before the section's top reaches the top of the screen.
phone: It runs on a phone as on a desktop (one paragraph's colours, no pin); under reduced motion the paragraph is in full ink.

needs.words: one paragraph of 25 to 60 words (never under 12), an optional small kicker over it and one line or link under it; the section data-screen="band", no picture

height: Sized to the paragraph and its padding (data-screen="band"), one screen at most; never a full screen round a few words.
